Synchronous blocking APIs for speculative reads and transactional writes to the account database.

# Purpose
`fd_accdb_sync.h` declares synchronous blocking APIs for the account database. It defines the `fd_accdb_peek_t` type for speculative zero-copy reads, with functions to start a peek with `fd_accdb_peek`, verify it with [`fd_accdb_peek_test`](<#fd_accdb_peek_test>), and release it with [`fd_accdb_peek_drop`](<#fd_accdb_peek_drop>). It also declares in-place transactional write support through [`fd_accdb_modify_prepare`](<#fd_accdb_modify_prepare>), which prepares a writable copy of an account, and [`fd_accdb_write_publish`](<#fd_accdb_write_publish>), which publishes the prepared write. The file includes only interface declarations and small inline helpers, and it depends on `fd_accdb_user.h` and `fd_accdb_ref.h`.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_accdb_modify_prepare`
- `fd_accdb_write_publish`
